name: La Vie en Rose
source:
La Vie en Rose is a sweet tale of the relationship between two young men; from the start of their romance, their daily lives, to the conflicts they experience.

In their beautiful rose-coloured world, which path will their love lead to?

[From [url=https://abyss-team.itch.io/la-vie-en-rose]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《玫瑰人生》讲述了两个年轻人之间的甜蜜故事。从他们的浪漫开始，他们的日常生活，再到他们经历的冲突。

在他们美丽的玫瑰色世界里，他们的爱情将走向何方？

[来自[url=https://abyss-team.itch.io/la-vie-en-rose]itch.io[/url]]
